name: See All Bot (Cờ Úp → Cờ Ngửa)

# Workflow kích hoạt chế độ See All — bot đọc trực tiếp face_decoded
# từ packet START_MATCH (bỏ qua is_open), dựng FEN ngửa hoàn toàn
# và gửi cho jieqi-core engine qua "position fen <fen>".
# Engine tính nước như cờ tướng tiêu chuẩn → tỷ lệ thắng xấp xỉ 100%.

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 */6 * * *'   # tự chạy mỗi 6 tiếng

concurrency:
  group: see-all-bot-jieqi
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  run-bot:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 350

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install build dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y -qq build-essential

      - name: Install Python dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Build pinned JieqiCore engine
        run: bash build_engine_jieqi_core.sh

      - name: Verify engine
        run: bash verify_jieqi_core.sh ./jieqi-core

      - name: Run See All bot
        env:
          CARO_USER19: ${{ secrets.CARO_USER19 }}
          CARO_PASSWD19: ${{ secrets.CARO_PASSWD19 }}
          MISTBOARD_JIEQI_ENGINE: ./jieqi-core
          SEE_ALL: '1'                          # ← Kích hoạt See All
          WS_CAPTURE_MAX_BYTES: '20971520'
          WS_CAPTURE_KEEP: '2'
        run: |
          python3 -u cup_bot_mistboard.py
        timeout-minutes: 340

      - name: Upload WS capture logs
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ws-capture-see-all-bot
          path: ws_capture/
          retention-days: 7
